recognize_zh: 高倍血片可見大量盔形細胞（helmet cell）、三角形與不規則的紅血球碎片（schistocyte），血小板極少，是微血管病變性溶血（MAHA）的典型血片。
features: Numerous schistocytes including helmet cells, triangular and irregular red cell fragments
No nucleated red cells or blasts in the fields shown; a single neutrophil at low power
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with conspicuous red cell fragmentation. At high power there are numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells and triangular fragments, with scattered microspherocytic forms. Platelets are markedly decreased, and no leukoerythroblastic features or blasts are seen in the fields shown. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia; in this clinical context (pancreatitis, normal ADAMTS13, negative Coombs), pancreatitis-associated MAHA-T is favored.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so TTP is separated by severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity (<10%), which was 91% here.
Also morphologically identical; distinguished by stool Shiga toxin/E. coli testing and complement functional or genetic studies, both negative in this case.
DIC shows schistocytes with prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which require coagulation testing rather than smear morphology.
These show round spherocytes without helmet cells or angular fragments, and immune hemolysis has a positive direct Coombs test.
